📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: November 9, 2026)

On Monday, November 9, 2026 (Reiwa 8), the Hanno City Excellent Construction Project Contractor Awards Ceremony was held. The award winners by category are as follows.

Civil Engineering Category: Nashiki Construction Co., Ltd.
Project Name: Municipal Road 1-2668-2 (Pavement Replacement Work in Sakae Town and Tayanagi Area)

Civil Engineering Category: Kaneko Gumi Co., Ltd.
Project Name: Municipal Road 8-129 (Disaster Countermeasures Work at Shomaru Pass)
Project Name: Municipal Road 1-1797-2 (Pavement Replacement Work in Tayanagi Area)

Civil Engineering Category: Yamato Construction Co., Ltd.
Project Name: Asu-Okokubo Line Road Development Work (Iwakita Section 3)
Project Name: Asu-Okokubo Line Road Development Work (Iwakita Section 4)

Mechanical Systems Category: Uno Equipment Engineering Co., Ltd.
Project Name: Misugi Dai Junior High School Building Special Classrooms Wing Air Conditioning Equipment Renovation Work (Mechanical Systems Work)
